title: isiZulu source-paired slide image viewer implementation audit
status: scoped UI change; runtime visual and phone review pending

change.learnerSurface: The separate View slide image dialog now includes the same current-slide isiZulu draft/source text as the normal and expanded player disclosure. The draft/source content has one JSX renderer used in both places.
change.pairSelection: The existing slideChoice=zu source resolver, silent-draft resolver, review-hold decision, and English-source fallback remain the inputs. The displayed text is still keyed by module and slide and does not change narration selection.
change.imageViewerLayout: Only an isiZulu viewer with available source text gets the vertical-scroll layout: its image remains in a bounded scrolling stage, followed by normal-size source text reached by scrolling the viewer. Image zoom percentage is applied only to the image. The panel begins visible without requiring a disclosure tap. Other languages retain the existing full-height image viewer layout.

all240PairGate.result: 11 passed, 0 failed; includes the all-240 exact registered source/recorded wording and title/hash binding check

bodyReviewAggregate.interpretation: These are bounded machine comparison dispositions, not fluent approval, audio listening, or validation of the English farming claims. Paragraph counts differ on 37 slides, so the source pairs by module/slide and does not claim one-to-one paragraph alignment.

semanticAndAssetEvidence.titleReportLimit: The title report covers headings only. It is not evidence for narration-body coverage.

priorReadOnlyInventory.note: Its body/media counts and limits are retained as prior inventory evidence. Current source-pair exactness is separately rechecked by the all-240 test at this implementation base. The inventory did not establish artwork-label translation or runtime offline behavior.

semanticAndAssetEvidence.artworkLimit: The source panel pairs narration-script text by module and slide. It does not transcribe or translate every label embedded in the existing image artwork; image identity hashes do not prove the meaning of its pixels.

runtimeReview.typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit completed successfully at implementation base
runtimeReview.phoneAndPreview: Not yet performed. Parent review and actual 390px phone preview are required before any visual quality claim.
runtimeReview.offline: Not tested in this task. No cold-start, whole-course offline, or cached-viewer claim is made.
runtimeReview.visualClaim: No claim that the new zoom layout has been visually verified.
